notes: Orange roadside board in Port Vila, mid-distance. MUSEE without accent. Not transcribed: the small italic taglines ('"Explore Vanuatu's Diverse Cultures"' / '"Explorez les Diverses Cultures du Vanuatu"'), 'Sponsored by' with a BRED Bank logo, and a second partly hidden white board behind the ring sculpture ('NATIONAL MU... author: Torbenbrinker

lines.text: THE UNIVERSITY OF THE SOUTH PACIFIC

notes: Trilingual (English/French/Bislama) fascia over a covered walkway, Port Vila; seen at an angle from below. L'UNIVERSITE is written without an accent. A small 'RECEPTION' plate is a distractor.

author: Graham Crumb
attribution: Photo: Graham Crumb, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vila-welkam-lo-vanuatu-1.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: AEROPORT DE PORT VILA BAUERFIELD INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT

notes: Terminal fascia in white letters on a blue band, seen at an angle (the left end is foreshortened). AEROPORT is written without an accent; French and English are mixed in one line. In front, a large group of people poses holding 'WELKAM LO VANUATU' letter boards with 'Vanuatu DISCOVER WHAT MATTERS' tourism logos (slogan distractor). A small plate at the far left end of the fascia is illegible.

author: Michael Coghlan from Adelaide, Australia
attribution: Photo: Michael Coghlan from Adelaide, Australia, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cafe_Deli_Sale_(23444126501).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted name on a blue fascia in Port Vila; Café with an acute accent. Orange 'SALE' / 'CLEARANCE SALE' window cards and an A-board are advert distractors; a person stands in the doorway. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Michael Coghlan from Adelaide, Australia
attribution: Photo: Michael Coghlan from Adelaide, Australia, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Closed_Shop_(23859615835).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hanging red-lettered shop board over a gated doorway in Port Vila; a romanised Chinese (Cantonese) store name. Small poster on the wall at right is illegible. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Phillip Capper from Wellington, New Zealand
attribution: Photo: Phillip Capper from Wellington, New Zealand, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Round_Efate_trip,_Nov._2006_-_Ernest%27s_Store_and_World_War_2_Museum,_Port_Havannah_-_Flickr_-_PhillipC.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted roadside stall/museum at Port Havannah, Efate. The fascia reads 'ERNEST' then a gap where letters have weathered off (a vertical stroke after T, probably the 'S' of ERNEST'S is gone), then 'ROAD MARKET' with red flowers covering the 'O' and a stroke after 'MARKET'. A float hides part of the 'E' in MUSEUM. Not transcribed: 'YOUR BEST SOUVENIR' board (partly hidden by the pole), 'SECOND WORLD WAR MEMORABILLIA. RUST IN PEACE.', 'FOR SALE AMERICAN COCA-COLA BOTTLE. AND DISPLAY PIECES OF WREKS.', and a 'W.W.II PLANE U.S.N.BASE' board with small dated lines.
source_title: File:Round Efate trip, Nov. 2006 - Ernest's Store and World War 2 Museum, Port Havannah - Flickr - PhillipC.jpg
source_categories: Espiritu Santo in World War II

author: Phillip Capper from Wellington, New Zealand
attribution: Photo: Phillip Capper from Wellington, New Zealand, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Natapau_church.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted board at Natapau, Lelepa Island, in mixed-case hand lettering ('WEL COME' split in two, lowercase-style e and a). Case is transcribed as it looks; an OCR match should be case-insensitive. SDA = Seventh-day Adventist.

author: Torbenbrinker
attribution: Photo: Torbenbrinker, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:PortVilaPostOffice.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Post office in Port Vila: 'VANUATU' arched over a wave logo with 'POST' below, on the white wall panel at right and repeated over the entrance. Distractors: 'WESTERN UNION MONEY TRANSFER' panel, 'ATM' plate, '...u Ltd' fascia cut off at left, door stickers. Relief mural at lower right.
